roleContext.jobDescription: A private bank onboards individual and corporate clients through a central team that checks identity, ownership structures and source of wealth before accounts open. The team leader reviews complex files, manages a team of onboarding analysts (work allocation, one-to-ones and performance conversations), handles escalations from relationship managers, keeps the onboarding procedures current and reports the weekly pipeline to the head of client operations. The onboarding team has eight analysts and one team leader, and files are reviewed against procedures that compliance owns and revises each year.

requirements.text: Reviews KYC files for individual and corporate clients against the bank's procedures.
Has managed a team of onboarding analysts, including work allocation and performance conversations.
Handles relationship-manager escalations on delayed files.
Keeps onboarding procedures and checklists current.
Prepares the weekly onboarding pipeline report.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Team Leader, Client Onboarding (KYC)

## Experience

- KYC analyst, then senior KYC analyst, at Holloway Private Bank from February 2020 to June 2024, reviewing onboarding files for individual and corporate clients, including trusts and holding companies with layered ownership structures.
- Quality-checked new joiners' files during their first month, returning each file to the analyst with comments and copying the team leader, and kept a log of recurring errors for the team's monthly refresher session.
- Answered relationship-manager escalations on stalled files, setting out the outstanding documents and an expected completion date, and logged each escalation in the team's tracker.
- Updated the corporate-client onboarding checklist after the 2023 procedure revision; the onboarding team leader and compliance approved the changes before they were published.
- Compiled the weekly pipeline report (files received, in review, awaiting documents, completed) for the team leader, using the case-management system's daily extract.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised quality-check sheet for a corporate onboarding file, with the candidate's comments on the ownership-structure documents and the source-of-wealth narrative, and the analyst's response to each comment.
